name: Affiliate Management for Ortiko
author: Gurmehub

sections.description:
Affiliate Management for Ortiko is a powerful WooCommerce integration plugin that provides comprehensive affiliate marketing solutions for your online store. This plugin seamlessly integrates with the Ortiko platform to offer advanced affiliate tracking, commission management, and partner relationship tools.

Key Features

  • Advanced Affiliate Tracking:
    Track affiliate referrals with precision using JavaScript-based tracking system that captures all necessary data for commission calculations.

  • Real-time Commission Management:
    Monitor affiliate performance and commission earnings in real-time through the integrated Ortiko dashboard.

  • Seamless WooCommerce Integration:
    Works perfectly with WooCommerce stores, automatically tracking orders and attributing them to the correct affiliates.

  • Flexible Integration Settings:
    Easy-to-configure settings panel within WooCommerce admin area for quick setup and management.

  • Debug Mode Support:
    Built-in debug mode for development and testing purposes to ensure proper tracking functionality.

  • HPOS Compatibility:
    Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) for optimal performance.

How It Works

  1. Installation & Setup:
    Install the plugin and configure your Integration ID and API Key in the WooCommerce settings panel.

  2. Affiliate Tracking:
    The plugin automatically loads the affiliate tracking script on your store’s frontend to capture referral data.

  3. Order Attribution:
    When customers make purchases through affiliate links, orders are automatically attributed to the correct affiliate partner.

  4. Commission Processing:
    All commission data is processed through the Ortiko platform for accurate tracking and payment management.

Integration Features

  • JavaScript Tracking Script:
    Lightweight tracking script that doesn’t impact your store’s performance while capturing essential affiliate data.

  • WooCommerce Settings Integration:
    Dedicated settings tab in WooCommerce admin for easy configuration and management.

  • Environment Support:
    Supports both development and production environments with appropriate script URLs.

  • Page Data Localization:
    Automatically passes relevant page data to the tracking script for accurate attribution.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.6 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Active Ortiko account with Integration ID and API Key

Configuration

After installation, configure the plugin by:

  1. Going to WooCommerce > Settings > Affiliate Management for Ortiko
  2. Entering your Ortiko Integration ID
  3. Adding your API Key
  4. Enabling the integration
  5. Optionally enabling debug mode for testing

Support

For support and documentation, visit Ortiko Platform

Third-Party Services

This plugin integrates with the Affiliate Management for Ortiko platform:

Service: Affiliate Management for Ortiko SAAS platform for affiliate tracking and commission management.
Website: https://ortiko.app/

Data Usage

This plugin collects and transmits order and customer data to the Ortiko platform solely for the purpose of affiliate tracking and commission management. All data handling complies with privacy regulations and is used exclusively for affiliate marketing purposes.

Privacy & Legal

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms of service and privacy policy of the Ortiko platform. Please review the platform’s policies to understand how your data is processed and protected.

  • Ortiko Terms of Service
  • Ortiko Privacy Policy

Affiliate Management for Ortiko – Grow Your Business with Professional Affiliate Marketing!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/partnerhub/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Affiliate Management for Ortiko
  4. Enter your Integration ID and API Key from your Ortiko account
  5. Enable the integration and save settings
